title: Frontend API Client, Vite Proxy & De-Mocking Core
acceptance_criteria: Vite server.proxy in vite.config.ts routes /api to http://localhost:5158 (with fallback to 8080) matching .NET launchSettings and container configuration.

src/api/client.ts aligns with .NET Minimal API DTOs: getItems unwraps { items: [...] }, cookRecipe sends { householdId, servings, mealType }, shopping list sync sends { lastSyncTimestamp, clientChanges }.
Request interceptor attaches W3C TraceContext traceparent and Idempotency-Key headers using crypto.randomUUID().
Response interceptor extracts ETag header from HTTP response and attaches it to response objects for Optimistic Concurrency Control.
Error interceptor correctly translates Axios errors into EdiensApiError containing RFC 9457 ProblemDetails and emits to errorBus.
